heroLead: Voyager Maps has 6,883 practical places mapped in Brisbane — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.

ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Brisbane on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Brisbane
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Brisbane it currently holds 933 public toilets and 1,868 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Brisbane is a city to carry a bottle in: it has 2.0 times more public drinking water points than public toilets — 1,868 against 933.
